title: ASSESSMENT AND MANIPULATION OF LATENT CONSTRUCTS IN PRE-TRAINED LANGUAGE MODELS USING PSYCHOMETRIC SCALES

bias_targets.methodology: Translating standard psychometric questionnaires (GAD-7 for anxiety, PHQ-9 for depression, and SoC-13 for Sense of Coherence) into Natural Language Inference (NLI) prompts and analyzing two-way normalized entailment scores to assess latent psychological constructs.
